description: Converts raw ADO.NET data access - SqlConnection, SqlCommand, SqlParameter, SqlDataReader, SqlDataAdapter, DataSet/DataTable, SqlBulkCopy - to a dual-provider shape for the dualdb tool. Use whenever a unit constructs a connection or command directly, reads a DbDataReader, fills a DataTable, casts an ExecuteScalar result, or catches SqlException. The SQL is only half the work; this skill covers the other half.
